ticket: J8 (#1261): the owner, 2026-11-14: "add ALOT more images to the UI. especially on stuff you can do."
prompt:
Use only the two pictures attached to this message (ignore any earlier pictures). They are tile sheets already in this painted isometric golf game: match their style, scale, framing, camera angle, detail level and colours exactly.

Create an image, 4:3 landscape: a sheet of TWELVE tiny isometric dioramas in a 4 x 3 grid. Each scene sits on its own small slab of ground, on its own dark navy (#1E2A44) rounded square; the twelve squares are the same size, evenly spaced, and do not touch, on a flat charcoal (#1C1F26) background. Light from the upper right, soft shadows falling to the lower left, warm autumn colours, the year 1985 (no modern things). NO lettering, numbers, logos or symbols anywhere: every sign, board, paper, tag and screen is blank. No people. Each scene must be easy to tell apart from the others at a small size, with one clear main object. Row by row, left to right:
Row 1: (1) a small-town brick bank front with two white columns, stone steps and a brass door; (2) a banded stack of green banknotes beside a blank signed-looking contract paper and a fountain pen on a desk blotter; (3) a brass bank-counter tray with an envelope of banknotes on it and a rubber stamp with its ink pad; (4) a pink ceramic piggy bank with neat stacks of gold coins beside it.
Row 2: (5) an open cash register drawer, 1985 style, with banknotes and coins in its compartments; (6) an open ledger book with ruled blank pages, a paper-roll adding machine and a pencil; (7) an open guide book on a wooden lectern with a lit brass desk lamp; (8) a blackboard on a wooden easel with a chalk drawing of a golf hole (a tee, a curving fairway and a flag, shapes only) and a piece of chalk.
Row 3: (9) a workbench with a wrench, a screwdriver, a brass gear wheel and an oil can; (10) a beige 1985 home computer with a blank screen and a 5.25-inch floppy disk lying in front of it; (11) a brand-new white golf ball on a wooden tee on perfect grass, with the low sun rising behind a small hill; (12) a leather golf bag with clubs, a blank scorecard on a clipboard leaning against it and a small silver trophy cup.
generator: ChatGPT image generation through the chatgpt-bridge (D:/AI/chatgpt-bridge), 2026-11-14
lighting: screen upper-right toward lower-left; soft shadows to the lower left; warm autumn colours; 1985
